integrity: The published symmetric-Minkowski-plane lemma reduces all unit isosceles-orthogonal pairs to quarter-turn partners. The new computation independently resolves the active dodecagonal facets, proves the two reduced profile branches and their monotonicity, and verifies the equality orbit symbolically. The bundled checker uses exact symbolic identities rather than numerical optimization. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact profile and equality classification are proved for the regular dodecagonal Banach plane only. No formula is asserted for all regular polygons.
title: Exact \(\Omega\)-profile of the regular dodecagonal Banach plane
